name: James Bond 007: The World Is Not Enough PC Port
summary: The 2000 PlayStation shooter, rebuilt to run natively on PC. This isn't an emulator or your average decomp! The game's code was decompiled, rebuilt for PC in the C language, and given a new "engine room": smooth motion at your monitor's refresh rate, sharp high-resolution graphics, mouse and keyboard or a modern gamepad layout, many new gameplay additions, and an entirely new Endless (high-score) Mode.
